description: Erection of an additional storey to create a one-bedroom flat
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (  1000; 1001; 1002; 1003; Unnumbered Design and Access Statement dated June 2020.
Received: 09/07/2020.
Energy Statement dated 31/07/2020. 
Received: 04/08/2020.
1004A; 1005A. 
Received: 08/03/2021.
) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - A) Notwithstanding the submitted plans and supporting documents; no development above existing roof level (excluding demolition; site investigations; or internal works to the existing building) shall take place until a revised energy statement (including drawings to show the location of any equipment to be installed on the exterior of the building) detailing measures to achieve compliance with the aim to achieve zero-carbon requirements of London Plan Policy SI2 and Local Plan Policy EQ1, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall thereafter be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy.
B) Prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development, where a contribution is found necessary to achieve compliance with zero-carbon requirements of the Development Plan, the developer shall have entered into an agreement with the Local Planning Authority to pay any carbon offset contribution at the published rate in-force at the time of submitting details pursuant to Part A of this condition.

Condition : 6 - Upon final commencement of operation of any low and zero carbon technologies, performance data for energy consumption shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The performance data shall be submitted every 18 months to a monitoring web-platform for a period of three years from the point of full operation.

Condition : 7 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105 Litres per person per day or less.

Condition : 8 - The developments shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of delivery notes, invoices or installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development meets the following:
o	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
o	At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
o	No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 9 - Prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development, details of secure cycle storage arrangements in accordance with both the London Plan and adopted Local Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The cycle parking shall conform to the WestTrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance and hard surface paths must be provided to the doors of the cycle stores. The cycle stores shall be made available to occupants upon first occupation of the hereby approved development and maintained as such thereafter without obstruction.
